221b8287bd91.title: Mechanical Design Intern - Immediate Fill
221b8287bd91.description_html:
Summary

GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale.

We help manufacturers improve shop floor workers’ quality of life, increase production capacity, and reduce scrap, repair, and rework costs. As a Mechanical Design Intern you will join our Mechatronics & Design Team to collaborate with our engineering team onsite in our Gardena, CA office to support the design process from concept to implementation while learning and contributing to the engineering team's objectives in a collaborative environment.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Supporting engineers and designers in creating, modifying, and refining mechanical designs using SOLIDWORKS

  • Creating 2D drawings and 3D models of mechanical components or systems based on specifications provided by the engineering team

  • Assisting in the development and testing of prototypes, which may involve assembling components, conducting measurements, and documenting results

  • Collaborate cross functionally with internal teams to improve, develop and/or review product designs

  • Collaborate with the engineering team to help document assembly processes and test procedures

  • Work closely with a team of cross-functional engineers to ensure seamless integration of hardware components with overall system design.

  • Prototype hardware considering design for manufacturability (DFM) using 3D Printing and/or CNC machines where appropriate

Export Control Requirements

In order to comply with the export regulations of the United States Government, it is required that the applicant must fall under one of the following categories: (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (i.e. current green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158.

Minimum Quals

  • Must be able to support at least 30 hours onsite in Carson, CA beginning October 2026

  • Currently pursuing or have a BS degree in mechanical engineering, related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • 1-2 years experience designing within SOLIDWORKS

  • 1-2 years experience demonstrating hands-on Hardware/Software skills

  • Experience with 3D solid modeling, analysis, and development of 2D manufacturing drawings

  • Proven track record of strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams and customers

  • Ability to solve problems effectively in a collaborative environment

  • Must meet export control requirements in the United States and maintain ongoing work authorization beginning at the time of hire through the entirety of employment.

Preferred Quals

  • Experience in rapid prototyping

  • Experience reviewing BOMs for completeness to support inventory management and system deployment 

  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes; manual machining, CNC machining, welding, sheet metal fabrication, plastic 3D prototyping

  • Experience with industrial robots and 6 DOF robotic arms

  • Familiar with industrial facilities and equipment

  • Basic experience with ROS, Python, and/or C++ coding

227a149567b6.title: Program Manager, Corporate Fellowship Program
227a149567b6.description_html:
Program Manager, Corporate Fellowship Program

Ft Carson, CO

CFP /Full-time /Hybrid

 

About Hiring Our Heroes

Hiring Our Heroes (HOH) connects transitioning service members, military spouses, and veterans with meaningful career opportunities through innovative workforce development programs. As a workforce initiative of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation, HOH partners with employers across the country to create pathways to long-term civilian careers while strengthening America's workforce.

If you're passionate about serving the military-connected community, building meaningful partnerships, and creating career opportunities that change lives, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

The Program Manager, Corporate Fellowship Program is responsible for leading and growing a local Fellowship Program site that connects transitioning service members with civilian employers through hands-on fellowship experiences.

This role blends program management, business development, relationship management, and community engagement. You'll work directly with military installations, employer partners, workforce organizations, and fellowship participants to deliver exceptional program experiences while expanding the program's reach and impact throughout your region.

Success in this role requires someone who enjoys building relationships, managing multiple priorities, solving problems, and creating opportunities for others.

What You'll Do

Program Management

  • Lead and grow a local Fellowship Program site while supporting assigned coverage areas.
  • Manage the full fellowship lifecycle, from participant recruitment and matching through fellowship completion and employment outcomes.
  • Plan and execute cohort programming, including orientations, professional development sessions, networking events, and graduation ceremonies.
  • Deliver an exceptional experience for participants, employers, and community partners.

Employer & Partnership Development

  • Recruit new employer partners and strengthen existing relationships.
  • Develop and manage a pipeline of prospective host companies using CRM and tracking tools.
  • Identify opportunities to expand program participation and increase regional impact.
  • Collaborate with employers to understand workforce needs and align fellowship opportunities.

Community Engagement

  • Build relationships with military installations, workforce development organizations, chambers of commerce, federal agencies, and community stakeholders.
  • Represent Hiring Our Heroes at military installations, career fairs, information sessions, and community events.
  • Increase awareness of the Fellowship Program through strategic outreach and engagement.

Operations & Performance

  • Maintain accurate program records and reporting within QuickBase, CRM platforms, and other internal systems.
  • Monitor key performance metrics and use data to improve program outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and enhance program effectiveness.
  • Ensure timely execution of program milestones and deliverables.

Collaboration

  • Partner with internal teams across Programs, Development, Digital, Marketing, and Operations to support successful program delivery.
  • Contribute to sponsorship and partnership initiatives that help expand program sustainability and growth.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who thrives in a relationship-driven environment and enjoys balancing strategic outreach with day-to-day program execution.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience with the military community preferred.
  • Experience in business development, partnership management, account management, or workforce development.
  • Experience building and managing a sales or partnership pipeline, including lead generation, qualification, and conversion.
  • Strong relationship-building and consultative communication skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to engage military, employer, and executive audiences.
  • Experience using CRM platforms or other data management systems.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform decisions and improve outcomes.
  • Highly organized with exceptional project management and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced hybrid environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve day-to-day productivity (such as drafting, summarizing, research support, and scheduling) while maintaining accuracy, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous learning as technology evolves.
  • Familiarity with workforce development programs, including DoD SkillBridge or military transition initiatives.
  •  

Preferred Qualifications

  • Military service or direct experience supporting the military-connected community.
  • Experience working with workforce development, talent acquisition, or employer engagement programs.
  • Experience planning and facilitating professional development or networking events.

 

Compensation

The Program Manager, Corporate Fellowship Program is employed by Markham LLC and assigned to Hiring Our Heroes.

Starting salary is determined based on experience, responsibilities, and market location.

 

Location & Travel

  • Hybrid position requiring residence within commuting distance of Ft Carson, CO.
  • Travel up to 25% is required.

 

Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally.

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) accrued based on years of service
  • 80 hours of paid sick leave annually
  • Nine paid holidays each year
  • Employer-paid medical insurance
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with up to a 3% employer contribution

We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, status as a protected veteran, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Our talent acquisition and employment policies are inclusive. We respect both the spirit and letter of the laws of equal employment opportunity.

$65,000 - $70,000 a year

 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
